changes.control_family_primary: 61 RAND (random orthonormal rank-r, per-module Frobenius norm = CAND, exact double-precision match) + 5 SHUF (role-swap + domain-deranged pairing fits, rescaled to CAND) + 15 DER (domain-deranged pairing fits WITHOUT role swap, rescaled to CAND) = 81 controls, floor 1/82 = 0.0122 < 0.025 (Holm first step).
changes.derangement: constructive (seeded cyclic domain map + within-domain permutation); rejection sampling removed (it failed at 670 rows)
changes.position_controls: KO_CWONLY_r = CAND applied ONLY at the codeword row; KO_ATLAST_r = CAND applied ONLY at the last prompt row (norm-matched by construction: same factors). Position contrast = CWONLY - ATLAST. KO_NEUT_r (fit at the last row, own norm) is DESCRIPTIVE; position claims rest on CWONLY vs ATLAST only.
changes.collapse_screen: median option mass < 0.05 on BASE/KO/KO_FULL/KO_IDENT/CAND => VOID; collapsed controls flagged + sensitivity rank test without them.
changes.decomposition: report d logp_concept and d logp_codeword (arm - KO) for CAND, CWONLY, ATLAST, NEUT.
